name: Élisabeth Louise Vigée Le Brun

summary.text: Élisabeth Louise Vigée Le Brun, also known as Louise Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun or simply Madame Le Brun, was a French painter who mostly specialized in portrait painting, in the late 18th and early 19th centuries.
summary.title: Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun

3937618: Marie Antoinette with a Rose, also known as Marie-Antoinette with the Rose, is an oil painting by the French artist Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun. It was painted in 1783, and is in the collection of the Palace of Versailles.
3937621: Marie Antoinette and Her Children, also known as Marie Antoinette of Lorraine-Habsburg, Queen of France, and Her Children is an oil painting by the French artist Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun, painted in 1787, and currently displayed at the Palace of Versailles. Its dimensions are 275 by 216.5 cm.
18719540: Self-Portrait in a Straw Hat is a self-portrait by the French painter Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun, painted after 1782, in oil on linen, measuring 97.8 by 70.5 centimetres. It has belonged to the collection of the National Gallery, in London, since 1897.
18923677: Portrait of Princess Maria Christina is an oil-on-canvas painting executed c. 1790 by Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun. Vigée Le Brun had taken refuge in Naples after fleeing Paris in 1789 during the French Revolution.
19005175: Self-Portrait with Julie is a 1787 painting by Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun showing the artist with her daughter. It is now in the collection of the Louvre.
19005202: Portrait of Countess Yekaterina von Engelhardt is an oil-on-canvas painting created in 1796 by the French painter Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun. Its subject, Yekaterina von Engelhardt, was a Russian noblewoman and lady in waiting.
Portrait of Countess Yekaterina von Engelhardt
19006513: Peace Bringing Back Abundance was painted by Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun in 1780 and is now part of the collection of the Louvre, in Paris.
19273424: Self-Portrait with Julie is an oil-on-wood painting by Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun, created in 1789 at the height of the French Revolution, which depicts the artist in a tender embrace with her daughter, Julie.
Self-Portrait with Julie (Self-Portrait à la Grecque)
19273465: Portrait of Joseph Vernet is an oil on canvas portrait painting by the French artist Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun, from 1778. It depicts her fellow painter Joseph Vernet.
19273481: Portrait of Hubert Robert is a 1788 portrait painting by the French artist Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun. It depicts her fellow painter Hubert Robert.
19361572: Self-Portrait Painting Marie Antoinette is an oil-on-canvas painting by Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun from 1790. It is held in the collection of the Uffizi in Florence.
19868575: Portrait of Hyacinthe Gabrielle Roland is a 1791 portrait painting by the French artist Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun depicting the courtesan and actress Hyacinthe-Gabrielle Roland. At the time of the painting Roland was living with the Irish aristocrat and Tory politician Richard Wellesley.
19905205: Catherine Noël de Talleyrand-Périgord was a French courtesan and noblewoman. Born in India as the daughter of a French Indies Company official, she married George Grand, a clerk of the British East India Company.
Madame Grand (Louise Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun)
19912372: Comtesse de la Châtre is an oil on canvas painting by Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun, from 1789. It is held in the collection of the Metropolitan Museum of Art, in New York.
21731529: Anne Pitt as Hebe is a 1792 portrait painting by the French artist Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun. It depicts the English noblewoman Anne Pitt, the daughter of Thomas Pitt, 1st Baron Camelford of Boconnoc in Cornwall.
28016074: Portrait of Charles Alexandre de Calonne is a 1784 portrait painting by the French artist Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun. It depicts the politician Charles Alexandre de Calonne, best known for serving as Controller-General of Finances between 1783 and 1787 during the reign of Louis XVI.
Portrait of Charles Alexandre de Calonne
41433015: Portrait of Countess Catherine Skavronskaya is a 1790 oil-on-canvas portrait by Elisabeth Vigée-Lebrun, now in the Musée Jacquemart-André in Paris.
55619837: Portrait of the Duchess of Berry is an 1824 portrait painting by the French artist Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun depicting the Italian Marie-Caroline, Duchess of Berry, a member of the reigning Bourbon Dynasty of France.
Portrait of the Duchess of Berry (Vigée Le Brun)
61041226: Portrait of Muhammad Dervish Khan is an oil-on-canvas portrait painting by Elisabeth Vigee-Lebrun, from 1788. It is held in a private collection.
61473576: Portrait of Madame Perregaux is a 1789 portrait painting by the French artist Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun. It depicts Adélaïde, the wife of the French banker Jean-François Perregaux.
62272805: Portrait of the Comte de Vaudreuil is a 1784 portrait painting by the French artist Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun. It depicts the French aristocrat, soldier and courtier Joseph Hyacinthe François de Paule de Rigaud, Comte de Vaudreuil.
Portrait of the Comte de Vaudreuil (Vigée Le Brun)
62571116: Madame de Staël as Corinne at Cape Miseno is a painting by the French artist Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun. It depicts Germaine de Staël and it is displayed in the collection of the Musée d'Art et d'Histoire, in Geneva.
Madame de Staël as Corinne at Cape Miseno
67185140: Portrait of Countess Golovina is a c.1800 portrait painting by the French artist Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun. It depicts the Russian aristocrat Varvara Golovina.
88966144: Lady Hamilton as a Bacchante is a c. 1792 portrait painting by the French artist Élisabeth Louise Vigée Le Brun. It depicts the English dancer and actress Emma, Lady Hamilton.
105731234: Juno Borrowing the Belt of Venus is a 1781 history painting by the French artist Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun. It depicts a scene from Greek and Roman Mythology.
Juno Borrowing the Belt of Venus
122974579: Portrait of Louise of Mecklenburg-Strelitz is an 1802 portrait painting by the French artist Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun. It depicts Louise of Mecklenburg-Strelitz the wife of Frederick William III and the queen consort of the Prussia.
